text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The 48-hour electoral silence ahead of local elections starts in Macedonia at midnight Thursday. Over 500 rallies were held during the 28-day campaign.

- Macedonian invetor Vanco Dimitrov won the grand prize at the international Eureka 96 innovations exhibition in Brussels for inventing a system of exhaust fumes protection, a project he worked on for 10 years.
- Since the opening of the Greek-Macedonian border 20 months ago 196,028 Macedonians visited Greece and 110,595 Greeks entered Macedonia.
- Six Macedonian school textbooks to be printed in Albania for the needs of ethnic Macedonian children there.

- Opposition IMPRO-DPMNY told a news conference there are 137,750 fictitious voters on electoral lists. "we do not doubt elections will be falsified, we can prove that" party secretary general Boris Zmejkovski said.

- International monitors of the OSCE expressed satisfaction Wednesday with the organisation and preparation for local elections. The elections will be monitored by the Council of Europe and the National democratic institute from Washington.
